lemma hasPosDensity_mod_one (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    {n : ℕ | n % m = 1}.HasPosDensity := by
  -- For arithmetic progressions, density is 1/m > 0
  exact HasPosDensity.mod_eq_one hm

lemma trivial_all_have_small_prime_factor (k : ℕ) (n : ℕ) (hn : n % (Nat.factorial (k + 1)) = 1) :
    AllHaveSmallPrimeFactor (k + 1) k n := by
  intro i hi
  rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hi
  have h_dvd : i + 1 ∣ Nat.factorial (k + 1) := by
    apply Nat.factorial_dvd_factorial
    omega
  have h_rem : (n + i) % (i + 1) = 0 := by
    have h1 : n % (i + 1) = 1 := by
      have := Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd n h_dvd
      omega
    omega
  have h_pos : 0 < i + 1 := by omega
  have h_fac_le : i + 1 ≤ k + 1 := by omega
  have h_le_fac : i + 1 ≤ Nat.factorial (k + 1) := by
    exact Nat.le_factorial (k + 1)
  have ⟨p, hp_prime, hp_dvd⟩ := Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd (by omega : 1 < i + 1)
  use p
  refine ⟨hp_prime, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have : p ≤ i + 1 := Nat.le_of_dvd h_pos hp_dvd
    omega
  · exact trans hp_dvd (Nat.dvd_add_self_right.mpr (by omega))
